obligations.obligation: Every event includes the contracted version, session id, turn id, sequence, type, and payload, with optional at.
obligations.mutation: Drop turn_id or replace the envelope with a binding-specific wrapper.

obligations.obligation: Sequences start at one and advance by one per turn; the three identity fields identify an event.
obligations.mutation: Start at zero, skip a sequence, reuse an identity, or interleave another turn's id.

obligations.obligation: Optional timestamps are UTC RFC 3339 values and event type values are registry strings.
obligations.mutation: Emit a local-time timestamp or a language class name as type.

obligations.obligation: Present every registered event type with its corresponding payload meaning.
obligations.mutation: Omit reasoning_final or type progress as freeform text.

obligations.obligation: turn_started carries fresh/resumed continuation and the actual primary provider/model.
obligations.mutation: Report the requested model when another model ran or label a resumed session fresh.

obligations.obligation: Output and reasoning deltas carry incremental text; reasoning_final carries the completed reasoning.
obligations.mutation: Emit cumulative text as an incremental delta or omit part boundaries from reply content.

obligations.obligation: Tool calls and results identify the built-in, caller, or MCP executor.
obligations.mutation: Relabel a caller effect as built-in or omit the source from a tool event.

obligations.obligation: Approval events represent a pending request and its correlated resolution.
obligations.mutation: Emit an approval decision with an unrelated request_id.

obligations.obligation: Progress is strict JSON, usage is a replacement snapshot, and terminal contains the turn result.
obligations.mutation: Emit NaN progress or represent usage snapshots as additive deltas.

obligations.obligation: Progress never indicates completion and no unqualified event type exists outside the registry.
obligations.mutation: Treat progress as success or accept a custom unqualified event type.

obligations.obligation: Preserve owned extension event types and fields verbatim without shadowing or registered-type coercion.
obligations.mutation: Drop an owned field, camel-case its key, or interpret an owned completion event as terminal.

obligations.obligation: A live turn has one first turn_started and one last terminal, including failure/cancellation; nothing follows it.
obligations.mutation: Buffer turn_started until work completes, omit a failure terminal, or publish after terminal.

obligations.obligation: Every tool call and approval request has exactly one later same-id resolution before terminal; cancellation drains them.
obligations.mutation: Publish an orphan result, duplicate a decision, or end a cancelled turn with a pending call.

obligations.obligation: Appending reply deltas reproduces terminal content exactly; reasoning_final equals its corresponding delta run.
obligations.mutation: Change delta order, flatten content-part boundaries, or alter final reasoning text.

obligations.obligation: Attributable model work produces usage; final usage follows all work, precedes terminal, and equals terminal usage when present.
obligations.mutation: Suppress usage after model work, emit it before the last tool-triggered model request, or alter terminal usage.

obligations.obligation: Success omits error; failure/rejection include one; cancellation distinguishes accepted-turn and approval cancellation codes.
obligations.mutation: Return success with an error or use approval_cancelled for accepted turn.cancel().

obligations.obligation: Recoverable failures appear as progress/tool results while unrecoverable failures end in terminal.
obligations.mutation: Throw a stream exception for an unrecoverable provider failure.

obligations.obligation: Payload evolution preserves established fields and unknown additional fields.
obligations.mutation: Discard an unknown optional payload field on binding round-trip.

obligations.obligation: Payload amendments retain existing names, types, and meanings.
obligations.mutation: Rename an existing event payload field in a minor contract amendment.

obligations.obligation: Bindings carry all events; faces retain precisely their declared projection with order and event boundaries preserved.
obligations.mutation: Filter an event in TS or merge two output_delta events in the HTTP projection.

obligations.obligation: Event names and payloads do not reveal composition, loop, prompt, or routing internals; delegation uses tool activity.
obligations.mutation: Register subagent_started or expose a prompt-fragment event payload.

obligations.obligation: Usage is sourced from actual work or omitted, never populated with fabricated constants.
obligations.mutation: Return a constant token count across scripts with distinct usage.

obligations.obligation: Progress data is actionable and does not contain engine-authored narrative or imply success.
obligations.mutation: Add narration-only progress text or document progress as proof of completion.

obligations.obligation: Do not add completed-turn replay or another freeform text channel.
obligations.mutation: Add a replay API or a second narrative text stream.

obligations.obligation: The public kit discriminates brackets, sequence, pairing, reconstruction, usage, all terminal states, registry, extensions, and binding order.
obligations.mutation: Accept a kit whose event validator also accepts an orphan result or missing terminal.

obligations.obligation: Static rules reserve the unqualified event namespace and require owned extension keys.
obligations.mutation: Register an unqualified custom event or an extension that shadows usage.

obligations.obligation: Event envelopes identify turn-events/1 independently of package releases.
obligations.mutation: Serialize a package version in the event contract_version field.
